rationale: The repository is split into five feature modules ordered by dependency: shared infrastructure first, lightweight data resources next, lexical analysis, model-backed inference features, and a final public API/integration layer. Each non-final milestone exposes behavior that can be tested without later milestones, while the last milestone verifies the complete documented xmnlp package surface.

milestones.title: Configuration, model base, serialization, and utility data structures
milestones.objective: Build the shared substrate used by every feature: model path configuration, BaseModel ONNX CPU wrapper, Module persistence helpers, Trie and BM25 utilities, package imports, and parallel processing helper.
milestones.risk_rationale: This milestone delivers the contracts that downstream pinyin, radical, lexical, summary, checker, sentiment, and sentence-vector modules import. Its gate can verify imports, path mutation, CPU-only BaseModel session construction through mocks, Module save/load round trips, Trie lookup behavior, BM25 scoring behavior, and parallel_handler execution without any later NLP feature existing.

criteria: xmnlp.config.path exposes mutable model and resource path configuration including MODEL_DIR and default package data paths.
BaseModel initializes an ONNX Runtime InferenceSession using CPUExecutionProvider and defines an abstract predict contract.
Module.filelist yields files for both single-file and recursive-directory inputs.
Module.save and Module.load round-trip ordinary attributes, sets, nested objects, compressed pickle files, and uncompressed pickle files while respecting __onlysave__ and __notsave__.
Trie supports add, get, and longest-prefix find behavior for Chinese strings.
BM25 builds corpus statistics and returns deterministic document similarity scores.
parallel_handler applies an arbitrary callback over an iterable with configurable job count while preserving result order.
corner_cases: MODEL_DIR is initially unset or set through an environment variable.
Module.load can read an uncompressed file even when iszip=True fallback is needed.
Empty directories and single files passed to filelist.
Trie lookup for missing prefixes, empty strings, and overlapping keys.
BM25 with empty documents, repeated terms, and query terms absent from the corpus.
parallel_handler with n_jobs=1, n_jobs greater than input length, and empty input.

agents.title: Specification test author
agents.mandate: Write executable tests for the infrastructure contracts in the design documents: path globals, BaseModel CPU provider use with mocked onnxruntime, Module serialization behavior, Trie prefix matching, BM25 scoring shape, and parallel_handler ordering.

agents.title: Contract author
agents.mandate: Implement the shared contracts exactly where documented so later milestones can import them: config.path constants, BaseModel, Module, Trie, BM25, utils package exports, and parallel_handler.

agents.title: Gate repairer
agents.mandate: If the infrastructure gate fails, fix only the reported contract or behavior failures without adding unrelated NLP feature code.

milestones.title: Pinyin, radical extraction, and resource trainers
milestones.objective: Implement local dictionary-backed pinyin conversion, radical extraction, pickle/resource loading, and trainer entry points for producing those resources.
milestones.risk_rationale: This milestone delivers standalone lookup features that depend only on Module and Trie. Its gate can train small temporary corpora, save/load generated resources, translate/extract radicals, and verify package-level pinyin/radical imports without lexical, neural, summary, or checker modules. Checker later depends on Pinyin for suggestion ranking, so mistakes here would propagate into spell correction.

criteria: Pinyin trains from a UTF-8 corpus, stores mappings in a Trie, persists through Module.save, loads default or configured pickle resources, and translates Chinese text to a list of syllables.
Radical trains from a UTF-8 corpus, stores mappings in a dictionary/hash map, persists through Module.save, loads default or configured pickle resources, and returns a list of radicals.
Unknown characters are returned unchanged or with the documented fallback rather than crashing.
PinyinTrainer and RadicalTrainer create model files from source corpora.
Package functions xmnlp.pinyin.translate and xmnlp.radical.radical are importable and delegate to lazy-loaded resources.
corner_cases: Mixed Chinese, ASCII, punctuation, emoji, and whitespace.
Empty input strings.
Duplicate corpus rows where later or first mapping must be deterministic.
Missing resource file with an explicit, understandable exception.
Multi-character trie entries and overlapping prefixes.
UTF-8 corpus lines with trailing newlines or extra columns.

agents.title: Specification test author
agents.mandate: Write tests that train tiny pinyin and radical resources in temporary files, verify save/load and lookup behavior, and assert the documented package exports exist.

agents.title: Implementer
agents.mandate: Implement Pinyin, Radical, their lazy package loaders, and trainer classes using the Module and Trie contracts from the previous milestone.

agents.title: Gate repairer
agents.mandate: Repair only failures in pinyin, radical, or trainer behavior reported by the milestone gate.

milestones.title: Dictionary and model-backed lexical analysis
milestones.objective: Implement Chinese segmentation, POS tagging, NER decoding, user dictionaries, fast dictionary tokenization, and the lexical ONNX wrapper/lazy loader.
milestones.risk_rationale: This milestone delivers the core lexical API that summary and the top-level package later rely on. Its gate can verify reverse maximum matching, jieba-format dictionary loading, user dictionary overrides, POS tags, BIO entity decoding with positions, and lazy model-path error handling using mocked models without needing sentiment, spell checking, sentence vectors, or final integration.

criteria: Tokenization loads system and user dictionaries compatible with jieba-style word frequency tag lines.
Tokenization.seg performs reverse maximum matching and preserves non-Chinese spans, punctuation, emoji, and ASCII words.
Tokenization.tag returns (word, pos) tuples with dictionary POS tags and sensible defaults for unknown tokens.
detect_new_word can be toggled and calls the lexical model only when enabled.
LexicalModel subclasses BaseModel and predicts from token_ids and segment_ids arrays.
Lexical decodes BIO labels into segmentation/POS/NER outputs and can include start/end positions for NER entities.
xmnlp.lexical package exposes load_lexical, seg, tag, ner, fast_seg, fast_tag, deep_seg, and deep_tag.
corner_cases: Empty strings and whitespace-only strings.
Traditional Chinese or unsupported deep-model text should not be silently treated as valid simplified-only deep segmentation.
Input longer than the documented 512-token lexical limit is split or rejected deterministically.
Overlapping dictionary entries choose the longest reverse match.
Malformed dictionary lines are ignored or handled without crashing valid lines.
BIO labels with orphan I tags, adjacent entities, and entity spans at the beginning or end of text.

agents.title: Specification test author
agents.mandate: Create tests for dictionary tokenization, jieba-format user dictionaries, POS tagging, BIO decoding, entity positions, deep/fast mode dispatch, and lexical package exports using small fixtures and mocked model predictions.

agents.title: Implementer
agents.mandate: Implement lexical_model.py, tokenization.py, and xmnlp.lexical exports according to the documented segmentation, tagging, NER, and lazy-loading behavior.

agents.title: Specification auditor
agents.mandate: Read the lexical implementation against the PRD, architecture design, and UML diagrams; report mismatches in symbol locations, signatures, sequence length handling, lazy loading, BIO decoding, or dictionary semantics.

agents.title: Gate repairer
agents.mandate: Fix the reviewer and gate-reported lexical deviations while preserving contracts frozen by earlier milestones.

milestones.title: Sentiment, spell checker, and sentence-vector adapters
milestones.objective: Implement the remaining ONNX-backed feature modules: sentiment probabilities, detector/corrector spell checking, sentence embeddings, similarity, and most-similar document search.
milestones.risk_rationale: This milestone delivers model adapter features that share BaseModel, configuration, tokenizers, and lazy singleton loading but are otherwise independent of summary and final top-level wiring. Its gate can mock ONNX outputs and tokenizers to verify CPU inference calls, max-length validation, probability conversion, correction ranking, pinyin-assisted spell suggestions, cosine similarity, and top-k search.

criteria: SentimentModel subclasses BaseModel and Sentiment.predict returns a two-float negative/positive probability tuple for text up to the documented length.
Sentiment package uses thread-safe lazy singleton loading and raises ValueError when MODEL_DIR is not configured.
DetectorModel and CorrectorModel subclass BaseModel and run prediction from token_ids and segment_ids arrays.
CheckerDecoder initializes detector, corrector, tokenizer, mask ID, and pinyin helper from the configured model directory.
CheckerDecoder.predict returns detected errors as (position, token) tuples when suggest=False and ranked suggestion lists when suggest=True.
Spell checker enforces the documented 512-token maximum with ValueError.
SentenceVectorModel subclasses BaseModel and SentenceVector supports transform, similarity, and most_similar with genre-specific model paths and top-k results.
All model modules use CPUExecutionProvider through BaseModel and thread-safe lazy loading locks.
corner_cases: MODEL_DIR missing or changed through set_model before lazy loading.
Empty sentiment/checker/sentence-vector input.
Sentiment input exceeding 150 tokens.
Checker input exceeding 512 tokens.
Correction suggestions with k larger than available candidates and max_k limiting internal candidates.
Similarity called with raw strings, numpy vectors, zero vectors, identical vectors, and k larger than document count.
Concurrent calls to lazy loaders should instantiate a singleton once.

agents.title: Specification test author
agents.mandate: Write tests with mocked tokenizers and ONNX sessions for sentiment, checker, and sentence-vector modules, including lazy loading, max lengths, probability/similarity math, and package exports.

agents.title: Implementer
agents.mandate: Implement sentiment, checker, and sv modules using BaseModel, tokenizers, numpy, scikit-learn KDTree where appropriate, Pinyin from the prior milestone, and thread-safe lazy singleton loading.

agents.title: Specification auditor
agents.mandate: Audit the neural feature adapters against the PRD and architecture documents, especially max sequence lengths, CPU-only ONNX usage, singleton locking, model path handling, and documented return shapes.

agents.title: Contract critic
agents.mandate: Audit the implementation against frozen contracts from core infrastructure and pinyin/radical milestones, reporting import path, BaseModel, config, Module, or Pinyin contract violations.

agents.title: Gate repairer
agents.mandate: Fix only the reported sentiment, checker, sentence-vector, spec, or frozen-contract deviations.

milestones.title: TextRank summary/keywords and full public xmnlp integration
milestones.objective: Implement TextRank keyword/keyphrase extraction, stopword customization, root-package API re-exports, model configuration functions, pinyin/radical/checker/sentiment/lexical wrappers, and final integration of all documented public contracts.
milestones.risk_rationale: This final milestone delivers the outward-facing toolkit consumers use: import xmnlp, call set_model, seg/tag/ner/keyword/keyphrase/sentiment/pinyin/radical/checker, and use subpackage classes. Its gate verifies the full public contract and catches wiring mistakes between previously frozen modules, plus TextRank behavior that depends on lexical tokens and BM25.

criteria: KeywordTextRank extracts top-k keyword and weight tuples using TextRank, stopword filtering, and optional allowed POS tags.
TextRank extracts top-k keyphrases/sentences using BM25 sentence similarity and returns strings in ranked order.
set_model updates the global model directory used by lazy model loaders.
set_stopword reads UTF-8 stopword files and merges them with system stopwords.
The xmnlp root package exposes documented functions: set_model, set_stopword, seg, tag, ner, keyword, keyphrase, sentiment, pinyin, radical, and checker.
Root package wrappers delegate to their owning feature modules and preserve documented return shapes.
All documented modules import cleanly on a clean environment with optional heavyweight runtime dependencies handled gracefully or mocked in tests.
Visible check_tests and milestone tests pass together at integration level.
corner_cases: Keyword/keyphrase on empty text, one sentence, repeated words, punctuation-only text, and text where all words are stopwords.
allowPOS is None, empty, or contains tags absent from the text.
k is zero, one, larger than available words/sentences, or negative with deterministic handling.
set_stopword file with blank lines, duplicate words, and UTF-8 Chinese content.
set_model called before and after importing feature subpackages.
Root package imports should not eagerly instantiate ONNX sessions before a model-backed function is called.
Parallel processing through xmnlp.utils.parallel_handler works with root package functions.

agents.title: Specification test author
agents.mandate: Write integration tests for TextRank keyword/keyphrase behavior, root xmnlp API wrappers, set_model/set_stopword side effects, import cleanliness, and representative end-to-end calls using mocks where model files are external.

agents.title: Implementer
agents.mandate: Implement summary.textrank, summary package exports, root xmnlp API re-exports and delegating wrappers, set_model, set_stopword, and final package wiring without breaking previously frozen submodule contracts.

agents.title: Specification auditor
agents.mandate: Audit the final public package against the PRD usage examples, architecture tree, and UML package diagram; report missing functions, wrong return shapes, eager model loading, or TextRank deviations.

agents.title: Contract critic
agents.mandate: Verify the integration layer preserves all frozen contracts from earlier milestones, especially exported symbol locations, constants, singleton loaders, and utility behavior.

agents.title: Gate repairer
agents.mandate: Fix reported final integration and public API failures, then ensure the visible check_tests and milestone acceptance tests pass together.
